metadata.title: Preserve HTTP status codes in email auth admin endpoints
metadata.author: shoummu1

description:
## :bug: Bug-fix PR

### :pushpin: Summary
Fixes HTTPException handling bug in email authentication admin endpoints where all HTTP exceptions (404 Not Found, 400 Bad Request, etc.) were being caught by generic `except Exception` blocks and incorrectly converted to 500 Internal Server Error responses.

The three affected endpoints now correctly preserve their original HTTP status codes:
- `GET /auth/email/admin/users/{email}` - Returns 404 when user not found (was 500)
- `PUT /auth/email/admin/users/{email}` - Returns 404 when user not found (was 500)
- `DELETE /auth/email/admin/users/{email}` - Returns 400/404 for validation errors (was 500)

### :link: Related Issue
Closes: #1841

### :triangular_ruler: Changes:
- **Backend**: Added `except HTTPException: raise` before `except Exception` in three admin endpoints
- **Error Handling**: HTTPException now properly re-raised with original status codes (404, 400, 401, 403)
- **Logging**: Generic exceptions still caught and logged as 500 errors
- **Comments**: Added inline documentation explaining exception handling pattern

**Files Modified:**
- `mcpgateway/routers/email_auth.py` - Lines 579-580, 637-638, 679-680

### :white_check_mark: Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (make black isort pre-commit)
- [x] All 71 unit tests pass (3 skipped as expected)
- [x] Error responses now match HTTP semantics (404 Not Found, 400 Bad Request)

commits.message:
Fix HTTPException handling in login endpoint

Preserve HTTP status codes (401, 403) in login endpoint using
the same pattern applied to admin endpoints. Without this fix,
HTTPExceptions raised for invalid credentials or password change
required were incorrectly converted to 500 Internal Server Error.

Closes: #1841
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
